body:
**Approved by the maintainer (2026-11-10): P1, open for agents to pick up.**

The open questions are answered with the recommended defaults, so a picking agent doesn't need to wait:
- **Pages source:** GitHub Actions deploys Zola's `public/` output from the tag-triggered `release.yml` job (Pages source "GitHub Actions"). Nothing generated is committed. Add no new triggers.
- **WASM timing:** ship the docs site first. Add `/app/` once #31 makes the app and UI build for wasm32; until then the front page says the browser build is coming. #31 stays its own issue.
- **First-cut content:** the user guide (install, first run, setups, operations, posting, reading a refusal) plus a short developer section (crate map, command/undo model, gate tiers, release process) drawn from AGENTS.md and README.
- **#291:** superseded by this issue (Zola instead of mdBook) and closed with a pointer here.
- **Actions minutes:** measure the added minutes on the first tag run and report them on this issue.

A picking agent follows AGENTS.md as usual: claim, worktree, draft PR, and `docs/decisions/688-*.md` for any further choices.
